Map every “near me” rank

Start with 10 free scans

“Near me” moves with the person searching

“Plumber near me” has no single answer — “near me” is wherever the searcher is standing, and the map pack recomputes for every one of them. Check that search from your office and you learn your rank at your office and nowhere else. Eagle Eye runs it from a grid of up to 441 real locations across the area, so you see the “near me” rank the way customers actually get it: block by block, not one number from your desk.

Why “near me” needs a grid

  • One rank is one location — “near me” is thousands; a grid samples the whole area in one scan.
  • Rank at every point, on Google Maps and Apple Maps alike.
  • LSOV — the share of the area where “near me” puts the business in the top 3.
  • A competitor map — which rival wins “near me” on the blocks you don’t.

New to the grid? See how geo-grid tracking works. Then run your own “near me” search for free — 10 free scans on a new organisation, your first own-site scan free up to 21 × 21. See what a scan costs.
